run_unified_guardrail_pre_call: run the unified guardrail async_pre_call_hook to modify input before LLM API call
run_unified_guardrail_moderation: run the unified guardrail async_moderation_hook to reject or accept input during LLM call
run_unified_guardrail_post_call: run the unified guardrail async_post_call_success_hook to check LLM response for policy violations
run_unified_guardrail_streaming: run the unified guardrail async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook to stream and guardrail LLM response chunks
build_litellm_metadata: build litellm_metadata from user API key dictionary using _ensure_litellm_metadata helper function
